items.title: How Revolut’s lean teams take on bigger challenges with OpenAI
items.summary: What can one engineer build when a project looks like it needs a whole team? At Revolut, an engineer used Codex to build an internal code review service himself. Its designers used Codex to turn seven years of design documentation into a format AI could read in a single day.
